__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A road begins here in the glowing sands.  You follow it through a gate
in a Plasteen wall onto the Megway of Mega-City One.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the glowing sand of the badlands.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8001 to 5062

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8001 to 8002

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Entrance to Mega-City One

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on one mile of over 13 and a half billion kilometers of
roadway in Mega-City One.  The Megway continues north and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The entrance to Mega-City One is in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8002 to 8001

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Mahmount Allesh Megway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The Megway intersects with Junket Way here.  Junket Way is to the east,
the Megway continues north and south, and the Pustule Palace Cafe is
to the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8003 to 8002

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Junket way continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8003 to 8010

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8003 to 8004

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Pustule Palace Cafe is in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8003 to 8021

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Intersection of Junket Way and Megway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The traffic here is really congested due in part to the over 11 million
people driving Mo-Pads, the mobile homes which are constantly on the
move until their owners can find an apartment in one of the City-blocks.
The Megway continues north and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: An intersection lies in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8004 to 8003

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8004 to 8005

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Mahmount Allesh Megway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The Megway continues north and south.  On the off-ramps here you see
many of the citizens of Mega-City One doing nothing.  You see of
every hundred citizens, it can be guaranteed that 87 of them will
be totally unemployed, and that a further five will not work more
than ten hours a week.  To the east there is a dark alley and to the
west is Rietzik's Shuggy Hall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8005 to 8004

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A dark alley lies to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8005 to 8011

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A large plaza is in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8005 to 8006

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A building is in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8005 to 8022

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Mahmount Allesh Megway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are at the Central Plaza of the downtown district.  There are a couple
of juves Boingging (tm) in the air above you.  Max Jaffa Boulevard goes
east, the Megway continues north and south, and Bazza's Home for the
Terminally Sarky is to the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8006 to 8005

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Max Jaffa Boulevard goes in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8006 to 8012

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8006 to 8007

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A home for Sarky people is to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8006 to 8023

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Central Plaza

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Another major intersection which is being negotiated by vehicles that
are bound to minimum speed limits.  Many Slow Driving offenses are being
handed out by the Judges.  The Megway goes north and south, a Parkway
goes east, and Nu Phisog Parlour is west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A plaza is to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8007 to 8006

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Ed Hilldreth Mem. Parkwy is to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8007 to 8013

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8007 to 8008

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A City Block lies to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8007 to 8024

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Corner of Ed Hilldreth Memorial Parkway and Megway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
As you travel the Megway you notice many citizens participating in their
favorite hobbies such as spot welding and metalwork, scratch building
fashion Kneepads, giving blood, or just looking out the window.  The
Megway continues north and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8008 to 8007

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Megway continues in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8008 to 8009

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Mahmount Allesh Megway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The Megway ends here.  To the west is Ziggi Piggi's Home for the
Semi-Stiff, to the east and south are construction areas, and the
Megway goes north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Ziggi Piggi's Home the Semi-Stiff is ahead.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8009 to 8025

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Mahmount Allesh Megway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: Junket Way a small Skedway continues east and west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Junket Way

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a very dark and seedy alley.  This is just the right place for
a bite fight.  Bite fighting is an illegal activity where both combatants
can only use their sharpened teeth as weapons.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Davies Alley

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: Max Jaffa Boulevard continues east and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A large plaza is to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8012 to 8006

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Max Jaffa Boulevard

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The Parkway goes east and west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Ed Hilldreth Memorial Parkway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A Mega-City One City Block is being constructed at this site.  A
typical block is from 100 to 1000 stories high with hundreds of
thousands inhabitants.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Construction site of the Harold Finkelbaum Block.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
There is a second-hand kneepad stall is doing a brisk business with a
group of juves on their way to school.  Junket Way goes west and Threep
Lane travels south.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Corner of Junket Way and Threep Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Threep Lane continues north and south.  There is a building to the east
with a sign next to the door.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A door to the east bodes ill.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 8016 to 8026

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: Throt and Gleep's Megger Store est. 2107

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Threep Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: Threep Lane continues north and south.  There is a dark alley to the west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Threep Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A proprietor of Uncle Sumpty's Ugly Emporium meanders by.  Threep Lane
continues north and south while Max Jaffa Boulevard goes west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Corner of Max Jaffa Blvd and Threep Way

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Threep Lane goes north from here while Ed Hilldreth Memorial Parkway goes
west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Corner of Ed Hilldreth Mem. Prkwy and Threep Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Construction is under way for the Black Atlantic Tunnel to connect
Mega-City One and Brit-Cit One.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Construction Site for the Brit-Cit One tunnel.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A scabrous hole.  Run by Ernie Ramirez, an ex-perp, it is a meeting place
for the low-life in the area.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Pustule Palace Cafe

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A sleazy dive and the meeting place of a lot of perps.  Shuggy is a
twenty-second Century version of pool, played on a hilly table, usually
with large side bets.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Rietzik's Shuggy Hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This is an experimental psychiatric home.  Named after a 20th Century
vid-critic, the home attempts, by various methods, to readjust the
socially unacceptable attitudes of the inmates.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bazza's Home for the Terminally Sarky

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Opened as a direct rival to the New You Face Parlour chain to offer quick
and cheap face-changing facilities to the general public.  However,
since the closure of Sump's Ugly clinics, the craze for face-changing has
died down.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Nu Phisog Parlour

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The only suspended animation parlour in the area.  It has a high turnover
rate.  It is rumored that the patrons are being used in body sharking and
organ legging activities.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Ziggi Piggi's Home for the Semi-Stiff

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This place promises to provide everything that the citizens don't need,
with the utmost discourtesy.  Of course, something as crazy as this was
bound to succeed.  There is a door to the north with a slot next to it.
There is also a sign next to the slot.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Throt & Gleep's Megger Store

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Many useless items stock the shelves of this stockroom.  A door leads
south and large vault door is to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This vault seems impervious to breaking.  There is a keyhole in the lock
however.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Stockroom of Throt & Gleep's Megger Store

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The vault is musty with a slight smell of ozone in the air.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Throt & Gleep's Vault
